description: Brazilian company record by CNPJ (14 digits or the alphanumeric format), with the public records linked to the company in `data`: sanctions (CEIS, CNEP, CEPIM, leniency agreements and TCU) in `data.sancoes`; the last CNIA check of monitored companies in `data.cnia` (for a live check, use consulta_cnpj); federal tax debt (PGFN) in `data.dividaAtiva`, installment agreements in `data.parcelamentos`, the tax regime (ECF) in `data.regimeTributario`, tax incentives (SISEN, ECF, DIRBI and import waivers) in `data.beneficiosFiscais` and construction works (CNO) in `data.obras`; the Federal Revenue chronic tax debtor list in `data.devedorContumaz` (`consta: true` means barred from public tenders); environmental and labor risk in `data.ambiental` (Ibama fines and embargoes) and `data.trabalhoEscravo` (forced-labor list of the MTE); government contracts on PNCP in `data.governo`; partners on the politically exposed persons list (CGU) in `data.pep`; registrations with regulators (CVM, Central Bank, ANS, ANTT, ANP, ANEEL, Anatel, Anvisa, CNES, Cadastur and Ibama) in `data.registros`; BNDES financing in `data.bndes`; federal government disbursements in `data.pagamentos`; sales to federal agencies by invoice in `data.notasFederais`; federal contracts since 2013 in `data.contratosFederais`; and election campaigns that hired the company in `data.campanhas`. A partner who is a person comes with the name masked (`LUIS F. R. P.`), and so do phone numbers and e-mail, with `data.mascarado: true`; a partner that is a company comes in full. The public answer can be reused for up to 6 hours; check the reference date of the records.

temas.description: Comma-separated topics: dados, socios, sancoes, fiscal, divida, obras, trabalho, ibama, contratos, pep, vendas, campanhas, prefeituras, sicaf, aeronaves, fundos, rntrc, bndes, registros; todos. Omit for the full record. Basic company data always stays. Unrequested blocks are omitted; null means unchecked. Personal data remains masked.
